game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Whisper Stones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Whisper Stones. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the crypt seal using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the crypt seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Whisper Stones'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Whisper Stones.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 13.
